name: scan-time-preflight-code-correction
body: Reconciliation of `solution.component.scan-time-preflight` (coordinator correction A) [with coordinator]. Source statement: the component body called `rust.apg.scan_time_preflight` "(planned)". Inconsistency: the function is real in the branch graph (`rust.apg.scan_time_preflight`, `src/main.rs:1024-1037`; verified via `apg_find_symbol`), and the component already carries `implemented-by` edges to it and to `rust.apg.spawn_frontend`. Resolution: removed the "(planned)" qualifier from the body and noted the real anchors; no edge was added, re-pointed or retired, and no planned Implementation node is involved. Extends the family reconciliation in `solution.note.frontend-dependency-contract-reconciliation`.
